pages.text: PeriscopeArt Browse NOW SHOWING STUDIOS CONTACT FOLLOW US Menu Browse NOW SHOWING STUDIOS CONTACT FOLLOW US Cake Studios, England This collaboration of 7 artists from all facets of design have come together to create one of the most exciting new studios we’ve seen in years. Designing for women, junior, contemporary and kids. Créations Robert Vernet, France Créations Robert Vernet was founded in 1957, and has become a world leader in textile designs. The studio crafts two thousand innovative designs each month for fashion, womenswear, menswear, children’s clothing, lingerie, beachwear, and home furnishings. Lemon Ribbon LR Studio is a British design studio specialising in prints and graphics for baby to teen, boys and girls. We create unique, on-trend designs for the fashion, publishing, stationery and home industries. Lewis Orchard, England Lewis Orchard has created year-round spring and summer collections featuring tropical, geometric, ethnic, and conversational artwork for fashion and interior design. Lewis Orchard is renowned for his draftsmanship, creativity, and use of color. Lewis Orchard Lylove Studio, New York Lylove Studio is a contemporary NYC-based textile design print studio owned by Jessica Sancilardi and Stephanie Daniele. They specialize in swimwear, resort, sleepwear, kids, t-shirt graphics, paper, and home furnishings. Made In Brighton The Made in Brighton portfolio is trend focused for the women’s, men’s, kid’s, swim and homeware markets. No two designs are the same, as we are always striving to present the most striking and inspirational textiles for our clients. Peaches Print Studio, England Peaches is a print studio with extensive recognition for being forward thinking. Inherited from its “Harika” days, the creators, Zoe & Sophie have over 15 years in the industry. Supported by a hand selected team this studio has impeccable talent and creativity. They continually push boundaries, cover the latest trends and ooze originality. Sam Morray, London This studio offers a contemporary mix of prints and t-shirt designs. All printed designs are held digitally and are supplied with layers and swatches if used in creation. Wakefield Design Studio Wakefield Design Studio is a US based studio whose compelling seasonal collections not only transcend trend and color research, but also reveal a strong understanding of their market and customer. They work with a carefully selected international team of versatile and talented textile designers who use a wide range of techniques to produce one-of-a-kind pieces of art. Each of their artists brings something exciting and unique to their seasonal print collections. Their collections focus on highly sophisticated and trend-right print designs for women’s wear, juniors, swimwear, home and accessories Whiston & Wright WHISTON AND WRIGHT LTD was set up in London in 1987 and the studio has been supplying the worldwide fashion market with their incredible designs ever since. Zinc Knit/Print Zinc is the premier knitwear and embroidery studio for the fashion and home industries. Dominique and Donna have taken color as it applies to sweater design to a new level. prev / next Back to STUDIOS 2 Cake Studios 2 Créations Robert Vernet 1 Lemon Ribbon 1 Lewis Orchard 1 Lylove Studio 1 Made In Brighton 1 Peaches Print Studio 1 Sam Morray 2 Wakefield Design Studio 1 Whiston & Wright 0 Zinc Knit/Print Powered by Squarespace
